When my heart feels restless and loud

A quiet read beside green pastures—full Psalm 23 panels live in the Lord is my Shepherd story.

Read-aloud

Sometimes bodies sit still but hearts keep running. The Lord is a shepherd. He does not hurry His sheep. He leads them to rest.

He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. Psalm 23:2 (KJV)

Still waters are not empty—they are calm. God knows how to lead us there, even on a loud evening at the table.

Gentle question

What would it look like to rest for one minute—shoulders down, breath slow—while the Shepherd stays near?

Short prayer together

Lord, when our hearts feel restless, lead us beside still waters. Help us rest in You. Amen.

Coloring idea

Green grass, a quiet pond, one sheep lying down safe. Color & Tell → Good Shepherd. Or Verse Image → Quiet porch (T17).
